project_type: Vite 5 + React 18 + TypeScript SPA — educational space game for ages 8–12
build_system: Vite 5 — build: 'tsc -b && vite build', quirks: path aliases need both tsconfig.json and vite.config.ts; all node_modules in workspace root
test_framework: Vitest 2 — command: 'npx vitest run' from workspace root; 219 existing passing tests; test files mirror src under tests/
build_command: cd "c:\Users\HP\Desktop\NASA SPACE APPS" && npm run build
verification_instructions: 1. Run 'npm run build' — must complete with 0 errors. 2. Run 'npm test' — all 219+ tests must pass. 3. Run 'npm run dev' and open http://localhost:5173 to verify visually.
snapshot_or_generated_files: dist/ is produced by 'npm run build' but should NOT be committed. No generated source files.
environment_constraints: Windows PowerShell. Workspace root is 'c:\Users\HP\Desktop\NASA SPACE APPS'. The dev server runs on :5173. All paths must be absolute or relative to workspace root. Server backend will run on :3001.
contribution_requirements: No 'any' TypeScript. All simulation constants need source URL comments. Keep all 219 existing tests passing. Simulation layer (src/simulation/) must never import React/Zustand. Pure functions only in simulation/. Coding standards: .kiro/steering/coding-standards.md
key_patterns: 1. Components: functional only, named interface props above component, max 300 lines. 2. Buttons: PrimaryButton with variant prop (primary/secondary/ghost/hint/danger). 3. Cards: Card component with sp-card CSS class. 4. Color tokens: Tailwind class names like text-spaceplus-text-heading, bg-spaceplus-accent-teal, etc. 5. Stores: Zustand with MissionState interface + MissionActions interface pattern. 6. Fire-and-forget API calls: void apiClient.method() — never block UI. 7. Route guards: RequireSetup, RequireMission, RequireMissionStarted wrappers in router.tsx. 8. Lazy imports: all route screens use React.lazy() in router.tsx. 9. ASTRA text appears in: LoadingScreen.tsx, TopNavBar.tsx, OnboardingScreen.tsx, AppShell title props, TopNavBar aria-labels, mission-progress-store (localStorage key 'astra-mission-progress'), useReducedMotion (storage key 'astra-reduce-motion'), AI prompt files.
directory_structure: src/app/ — router. src/ai/ — AstroAssistant + prompts + schemas. src/components/ — common/ (Card, PrimaryButton, UserChip, StarScore, LoadingScreen), charts/ (MiniProgressBar, ResourceBar), feedback/ (EventCard, AstroPanel), layout/ (AppShell, TopNavBar, ScreenTransition). src/data/ — missions/ (mission-definitions.ts, mission-progress.ts), nasa/ (moon-profile.ts, mars-profile.ts, life-support-constants.ts). src/features/ — onboarding/, planet-selection/, crew-selection/, base-configuration/, location-selection/, mission-control/, mission-debrief/, missions/. src/hooks/ — useMissionControl.ts, useAstroContext.ts, useReducedMotion.ts. src/services/ — mission-task-evaluator.ts. src/simulation/ — core/ (simulation-engine, mission-scoring, prng, simulation-clock), events/ (lunar-events, martian-events, event-engine, event-registry), planets/ (planned: location-modifier.ts), systems/ (life-support, power, agriculture, radiation), types/. src/store/ — mission-store.ts, mission-progress-store.ts, app-store.ts. tests/ — mirrors src/ structure.
